section_summary.extract_value: This section reports convergent validity correlations between the BAS-2 total score and other variables. It states that body appreciation was negatively associated with BMI among women and positively associated with BMI among men, notes a significant curvilinear association in men with BMI^2 (r = .12, p = .006), and reports a positive correlation between body appreciation and age in men but not women.
section_summary.evidence_source: The correlation coefficients between the total score of the BAS-2 and other study variables are summarized in Table 2. Body appreciation was negatively associated with BMI among women while positively correlated among men. Moreover, because the relationship between body image and BMI may be curvilinear in men, the correlation between body appreciation and BMI2 was examined. The correlation coefficient between body appreciation and BMI2 was significant, r = .12; p = .006, in men. There was a positive significant correlation between body appreciation and age in men, but not women.
